<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingDetails" name="Personal information and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Reminder" name="Reminder and check-in or boarding instructions"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Begin ticket search"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Search" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Select" name="Select route, date, and time"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveTicket" name="Ticket received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveTicket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravel" name="Post-travel feedback or services?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Journey" name="Journey completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostTravel" name="Provide post-travel feedback or use services"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PostTravel" name="Post-travel activity completed"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Reminder" name="Receive pre-travel reminders" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Reminder" name="Reminder received before travel" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Reminder" messageRef="Message_Reminder"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Reminder" name="Reminder received"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_1" sourceRef="Start_Reminder" targetRef="End_Reminder"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_Search"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_Search" targetRef="Task_Select"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_Select" targetRef="Task_SubmitDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDetails" targetRef="Event_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="End_Journey" name="No post-travel activity" default="true"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="Task_PostTravel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">feedbackOrServiceProvided</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" sourceRef="Task_PostTravel" targetRef="End_PostTravel"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel company booking" isExecutable="false">

    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_BookingSplit" name="Send ticket and update inventory"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ChannelChoice" name="Choose ticket delivery channel" default="Flow_Channel_SMS"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicketEmail" name="Send ticket via email" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicketSMS" name="Send ticket via SMS" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ChannelMerge" name="Merge ticket delivery channels"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_BookingJoin" name="Ticket sent and inventory updated"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderChoice" name="Send pre-travel reminders?" default="Flow_NoReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Message_Reminder"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_3" sourceRef="Gateway_BookingSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ChannelChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Channel_Email" sourceRef="Gateway_ChannelChoice" targetRef="Task_SendTicketEmail">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inventory_ToJoin" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_BookingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_4" sourceRef="Gateway_BookingJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice" targetRef="Task_SendReminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">remindersAreToBeSent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reminder" name="Pre-travel reminders and instructions" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Start_Reminder" messageRef="Message_Reminder"/>

</bpmn:definitions>
